review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Responsibilities - Review approved PFDs, P&IDs, equipment lists, process datasheets, specifications, and project requirements. - Prepare mechanical RFQ packages and evaluate suppliers’ technical offers, deviations, and compliance with project requirements. - Coordinate mechanical requirements and interfaces with process, civil, electrical, instrumentation, procurement, production, and site teams. Qualifications and Requirements - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. - 3–5 years of relevant experience in mechanical technical-office or design work. - Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office.
